children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Add REST, SSE, or WebSocket behavior while preserving authentication, scoping, audit, and agent-proxy invariants.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: A route is incomplete until permission, cluster and namespace scope, safe errors, audit, tests, and docs are defined.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Handlers stay close to Kubernetes resources while enforcing session, CSRF, permission, scope, and safe-error contracts.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Declare auth/RBAC, namespace, cluster, errors, and audit for every route.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Mutations require session credentials and CSRF.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Document external service-account behavior explicitly when available.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Cluster events, console, logs, files, players, mods, status, and actions use different transports and upstreams.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Console and game logs are WebSockets through the agent.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Pod logs come from Kubernetes and fail differently from agent streams.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Mount once, add permission where needed, map errors centrally, test the right layer, and update UI and reference docs together.

children.name: Edit Page Body
children.text: Found a gap? Open a docs issue or suggest an edit on GitHub.
